instruction: Buy me the top-rated portable air conditioner that's available now on amazon for each of my sisters, and have it delivered to their homes with gift wrapping. I want to give them identical gifts.
notes: Assumes two sisters (sister-1, sister-2) found via phone.search_contacts(relationship="sister"); the actual count is only known at runtime. Top-rated available product is found with amazon.search_products(query/product_type="portable air conditioner", sort_by="-rating"), selecting the highest-rated product that is in stock. For each sister: add her home address (parsed from contact home_address) on Amazon, add the product to the cart with quantity 1 and clear_cart_first=true (so each order has exactly one item), add gift wrapping (quantity 1), then place the order with the supervisor's Amazon payment card. place_order empties the cart state so the cycle repeats for the next sister. Payment card id is read from amazon.show_payment_cards. supervisor-complete-task takes the two gifted persons as record parameters (not API args) so its precondition mirrors the goal; no answer is passed.
